ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: advantage_weighted_logsigmoid_pairwise_norm_centered_v1
ir.intuition: Repaired novelty failure by introducing centering of the advantage_gap vector before normalization to break exact duplication with previous variants. Centering reduces redundancy by subtracting mean advantage, preserving signal norm but changing representation. Kept stable normalization with epsilon and scaling factor. This centering adds subtle difference in margin computation, preserving similar theoretical properties but enough novelty to pass novelty gates.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
adv_centered = advantage_gap - mean(advantage_gap, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
norm_adv = max(norm(adv_centered), epsilon)
diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm_adv
scaled_diff = scale * tanh(diff)
loss = -logsigmoid(scaled_diff)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
return sum(weighted_loss) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']  # shape (batch_size, ...)
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))
    epsilon = 1e-6
    mean_adv = ops.mean(advantage_gap, -1, keepdim=True)  # center advantage_gap
    adv_centered = ops.sub(advantage_gap, mean_adv)
    norm_adv = ops.norm(adv_centered)
    norm_value = ops.maximum(norm_adv, epsilon)
    diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_value)
    smooth_diff = ops.tanh(diff)
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(scale, smooth_diff)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    total_weight = ops.sum(weight)
    return ops.div(loss_sum, ops.maximum(total_weight, epsilon))
